end.summary:
Recognised halves, thirds and quarters in equal-part shapes.
Practised naming a fraction as parts out of the whole.
Found 1/2 of 10, 1/3 of 12 and 1/4 of 20 correctly.
Found 1/3 of 9 as 3 using equal groups.
Still had some confusion between parts coloured and parts left; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Nisha practised identifying equal shares and finding fractions of collections. They used equal groups and sharing to find answers such as 1/3 of 12 = 4 and 1/4 of 20 = 5. They first mixed up coloured parts with uncoloured parts, but corrected this by counting all parts in the whole and identified 3/4; the confusion was still mentioned later. At home, use paper shapes or fruit to ask, “How many equal parts altogether, and how many are shaded or taken?”
